name: Tip the Mouse
description: In his tiny meadow village, curious little mouse Tip enjoys fun and adventure while learning about the world with his furry friends and family.

videos.title: Down with the Rules
videos.overview: Tip decides that rules are boring and useless. Will a day without rules be enough to change Tip's mind?

videos.title: Shazam!
videos.overview: Tip and his Mum are visiting Jody and Marilou. The pups are pretending to be wizards, jumping and chanting to cast a spell.

videos.title: I Don't Want to Take a Bath!
videos.overview: Stinky Tip says no to a bath, but soon finds no one wants to be near him.

videos.title: I want to go with you
videos.overview: While Mum and Dad go to visit friends, Tip and Tippy will have to stay with their aunts, spending the night at their house.

videos.title: Boys Are Better Than Girls
videos.overview: Tip gets into trouble with Betty after claiming that boys are better than girls.

videos.title: The toys are mine
videos.overview: Lily, a neighbour and friend of Tip's mum, comes to visit. She brings along Gugu, her 18 month old son. Tip's mum has arranged a play date for the kids.

videos.title: I want to win!
videos.overview: Jumper, the gym teacher, has organised a run for the kids. Tip and Jody form their own team - and they're definitely going to win!

videos.title: Wake up, it's snowing!
videos.overview: Today Tip's village woke up under a soft layer of snow. Tip is enthusiastic about it and wants to play with his sled all day long!

videos.title: Telling tall tales!
videos.overview: Tip seems to have a great imagination today, coming up with all kinds of fibs and exaggerated stories to his family.

videos.title: You're Not My Friend Any More!
videos.overview: Tip is having a bad day at kindergarten. He is convinced that his friend Jody is definitely betraying him and that he doesn't want to play with him anymore!

videos.title: Babysitters are monsters!
videos.overview: It's Saturday evening and Tip's parents are going out for dinner. Tip and Tippy will stay at home with the babysitter.

videos.title: A pet for Tip
videos.overview: It's a warm spring day and Tip finds a caterpillar in the garden. He wants to bring it into the house and begs his parents to let him keep his pet.

videos.title: I'm not hiding!
videos.overview: Tip is playing hide and seek and he hides behind a sweater that Marylou has hung out to dry in the garden and he accidentally frays it.

videos.title: Nothing scares brave pirates!
videos.overview: It's a sunny day and Tip is having fun playing with his friends on the banks of the creek.

videos.title: I want to be a policeman!
videos.overview: Maggie is preparing a very special day. The pups will have the opportunity to experience a real job!

videos.title: I want to be handsome
videos.overview: Tip's Mum plans to take a photo of the whole family.

videos.title: Scary dark!
videos.overview: It's an evening summer and Tip doesn't want to go to sleep. He is afraid of the dark in the bedroom.

videos.title: Jody's favourite toy
videos.overview: Jody lends Tip his favourite robot toy. Tip goes enthusiastic to his aunt's house, bringing Jody's toy with him.

videos.title: I will never eat veggies!
videos.overview: It's lunchtime, Tip and Tippy are staying at their grandparents place and Tip doesn't want to eat his vegetable soup, he even refuses to just taste it.

videos.title: What a fear of the storm!
videos.overview: A storm during the pajama party frightens pups and tests two fearless friends.

videos.title: In dad's crib
videos.overview: Tip stays home with Dad while Mom is away; Tip promises not to disturb dad, but soon gets bored.

videos.title: Finding Teddy
videos.overview: Teddy falls out of Tip's backpack; Tip tries to find him with Betty's help.

videos.title: I am not going to the Doctor's
videos.overview: Tip has a cold but doesn't want to go to the doctor; Tip tries to escape going to the doctor.

videos.title: I am not good at this!
videos.overview: Tip goes to Jody's to work on his costume for the masquerade, but is discouraged after seeing hers.

videos.title: A guest at my house
videos.overview: Tip is excited that Billy is coming over to his house but this soon changes when Billy is not paying all his attention to him.

videos.title: I want to play!
videos.overview: Tip has the idea to give a concert to Maggie for her birthday.

videos.title: I Am Not Tired At All!
videos.overview: Tip doesn't want to go to bed at bedtime. Left alone in the living room, Tip seems satisfied with his victory. He's going to stay up late.

videos.title: Work is Not Fun At All!
videos.overview: Sadly Dad can't join the family for a trip to the river, because he has a job commitment. Tip decides that work is a very awful thing and you don't need it.

videos.title: I want my mommy!
videos.overview: Tip's mother takes him to his circus lessons. But the moment his mother is about to leave, he finds it a bit scary. He makes up all sorts of excuses to keep his mother there with him.

videos.title: I can't stand good manners
videos.overview: Leo gets bored of always being nice and polite to everyone, so he and his friends play the cheeky badger game. Unfortunately, they do so much nonsense that quickly everyone is angry with Leo. Of course, he doesn't like that either.

videos.title: I Didn't Mean It
videos.overview: Today Tip is going to learn how to play tennis, however, Jumper forgets to bring enough rackets.

videos.title: I'll Be Angry Forever
videos.overview: Leo and his family want to visit Aunt Nina and Aunt Lina by bike. However, when time is running out, Leo's parents decide to take the car. This makes Leo so mad that he wants to be angry forever.

videos.title: I'll Help You Mum
videos.overview: Tip wants to help his Mum who is very busy with her job, she has to bake many cakes for Mr Paco's store today.

videos.title: Who Finds It, Keeps It
videos.overview: Tip and his friends are searching for treasures that they have to put in a box they got from Maggie.

videos.title: The Super-mega-funny Joke
videos.overview: Jody is very fond of making jokes and playing pranks to make everybody laugh. Tip would like to be as good as Jody at making people laugh.

videos.title: Tasty Sweets
videos.overview: Today Tip can't wait for afternoon snack time, because Mum has planned something special: Betty, Henry and Tessa are coming over.

videos.title: I'm Not Ice-Skating
videos.overview: It's winter and snow has covered the village. There is a beautiful surprise waiting for the pups: Mum takes Tip, Jody and Henry ice-skating.

videos.title: I won't play anymore
videos.overview: The annual village fair is held. Tip learns to take care of nature. Today Tip is very lazy.

videos.title: Taking Care of Nature
videos.overview: Maggie and the pups have just finished having an afternoon snack in the forest. The teacher recommends the pups to take care of nature and pick up all the trash.

videos.title: I Want to be as Tall as a Tower
videos.overview: Tip thinks that being tall is much better than being short, as there are so many things that you are able to do then.

videos.title: The Magic of Recycling
videos.overview: The annual Marionette Show is coming up and each pup will make his own marionette for it.

videos.title: I want it!
videos.overview: Tip wants a toy he saw in Paco's shop, but his mother points out that it's not his birthday and he already has a lot of them. Tip protests and his mother, tired of Tip's complaining, comes up with a punishment.

videos.title: How boring bad weather
videos.overview: Tip is looking forward to the picnic with his grandfather and grandmother. But when it starts to rain, they have to stay inside which makes Tip feel bored and fed up. Fortunately, grandma and grandpa come up with all kinds of fun things to do.

videos.title: It's Just a Bad Dream
videos.overview: Tip awakes shouting after having a bad dream. Tip recounts how he dreamt of being attacked at the playground by a big black dragon.

videos.title: Let's Go Camping
videos.overview: It's a nice summer morning and Tip's family is getting ready to go camping on the riverbank.

videos.title: It's Fun to be Nice
videos.overview: It's Saturday morning and Tip is surprised to see his mother being busy and ready to leave the house.

videos.title: Don't touch my tuft
videos.overview: The family is having breakfast, but Tip's tuft is so long that he can't even see what is in the bowl in front of him. They take a trip to the hairdressers.

videos.title: A Promise Is A Promise!
videos.overview: Tip promises to let Jody play with his new toy car, but keeps putting it off until later. But when Dad has to change the plans they made together, Tip realises that he needs to keep his promise to Jody.

videos.title: The Most Precious Gift in the World
videos.overview: It's Mum's birthday today, and the family are planning to celebrate this special day with a surprise party for her.

videos.title: I'll Tidy Up Later
videos.overview: Tip has just finished playing in his bedroom, and now the room looks like a battlefield: there are toys everywhere. Mum tells them to clean up before they go outside, but Tip doesn't feel like it.

videos.title: Being Little Is No Fun
videos.overview: Tip is at his grandparents' house with Tippy, Mum and Dad. All the adults are doing things Tip wants to do too.

videos.title: I want a bedroom of my own
videos.overview: Tip discovers that Jody has his own bedroom and now he wants his own bedroom too! But maybe it's not so nice sleeping alone.

videos.title: Enjoy now!
videos.overview: The teacher has organized lots of great games. Tip, however, is in a hurry; he wants to go to the river as soon as possible to throw stones.

videos.title: Just wait!
videos.overview: Tip, Jody and Coniglietta have made a beautiful cake! They have to wait for it to be baked before they can eat it. But it's not easy being patient...

videos.title: Halloween
videos.overview: While doing trick or treat, Tip and his friends hear strange noises in Mr. Paco's shop. Maybe it's... a monster!

videos.title: The toothles monster
videos.overview: While playing with his friends in the garden, Tip notices that his front tooth is wobbly... and that maybe he is turning into a toothless monster!

videos.title: A bad mood
videos.overview: Tip is infecting everyone with his bad temper, from Tippy to his kindergarten friends. What if it's a contagious disease?

videos.title: Mister Winter
videos.overview: What a horrible winter! Tip doesn't really like it, his paws freeze and he can't go swimming. But maybe his grandparents can change his mind.

videos.title: Saying sorry is not easy
videos.overview: Tip wants to win a quiz in kindergarten and decides to team up with Ciuffi. But Jody, his best friend, is hurt.

videos.title: Don't be jealous Tip!
videos.overview: Tip won a medal at school, but his aunts don't care; they seem to be more interested in little Tippy. Tip feels jealous of his little sister.

videos.title: Look in the right way
videos.overview: Everything is ready, today the aunts will take Tip and Tippy to the lake for a picnic! But then the car breaks down and the perfect day seems ruined.

videos.title: Together is better
videos.overview: Tip wants to build a snowman in kindergarten, but his friend Jody is sick at home and no one else is listening to him. He decides to do it on his own!

videos.title: We're all artists!
videos.overview: Tip and Jody discover that Mr. Paco is a good painter. So they try painting too, with very disappointing results.

videos.title: The great mystery
videos.overview: Tip, Jody and Coniglietta find a key which will surely reveal some hidden treasure! Now they just have to find out where the treasure is...

videos.title: The pyjama party
videos.overview: Tip decides to have a fabulous sleepover, but then discovers that his home is being painted. How will his friends sleep with that terrible smell?

videos.title: I can't do it!
videos.overview: Tip, Jody and Coniglietta are making paper airplanes. But Tip is not very good and even his friends' encouragement doesn't help him much.

videos.title: What an effort!
videos.overview: Dr. Codoni and Tip's dad take their little ones out for a trip. Soon, however, Tip and Ciuffi get tired and make up a thousand excuses to go home.

videos.title: You can learn from your mistakes
videos.overview: How lovely to work in Mr. Paco's shop! Tip is soon disappointed, however, because despite his commitment he continues to create a lot of trouble.

videos.title: Let's make up!
videos.overview: Jody arrives at the playground with his new ball! Now they just have to decide what to play. But choosing is not so easy.

videos.title: I want to be brave too!
videos.overview: Tip would like to be brave like Raphael, Miguel's twin brother, who performs in a circus. But it is very difficult to not be afraid.

videos.title: The best dad in the world!
videos.overview: Tip is sure that his father is the strongest in the world and that together they will win the parent and child competition at the playground!

videos.title: I don't like change!
videos.overview: Tip is looking forward to spending the afternoon with his grandparents and Jody wants to go with him too. This time, however, there is some news...

videos.title: He did that!
videos.overview: Tip's grandfather has given him a beautiful carved pencil. Jody would like one too! But then the precious object disappears: who has taken it?

videos.title: It's got to be different
videos.overview: Tip and Jody are worried when they find that there are some things they don't agree on. Can they be best friends even if they are not exactly alike?

videos.title: A little help
videos.overview: Tip is only interested in his new little fish friend and he doesn't listen to his parents and Tippy asking for help.

videos.title: No!
videos.overview: After listening to a fairy tale, Tip decides to become a good boy and to say yes to everything and everyone for the whole day.

videos.title: I can do it by myself!
videos.overview: Everything is ready for the scavenger hunt. Tip is sure he will be very good at it so he decides not to team up with anyone and completes it alone.

videos.title: The mystery of the woods
videos.overview: Tip, Billy, Offy and their fathers are going camping in the woods. Dr. Bigtail tells the children the story of the elf in the woods, who can make your wishes come true – if you can find him. The pups are fascinated by the story and go off into the woods in search of the elf. But will they find him before their fathers find them?

videos.title: Magic Mommy
videos.overview: Tip just cannot fool Mommy! She always knows exactly what’s going on! How does she do it? Tip is convinced that Mommy is magic, and he follows her about all day to try and find out what her magic is.

videos.title: The world in the mirror
videos.overview: Tip is tired of the same old routine every day: brush your teeth, put your pyjamas on, go to bed… What would the world be like if everything were backwards, like in a mirror, he wonders. And suddenly, Mommy becomes messy and frivolous, Billy becomes a bully, and Jody can’t seem to get anything right: everything is backwards! And it’s not really much fun at all...

videos.title: A Real Hero
videos.overview: Tip wants to be like his favourite comic-book superhero, but nothing he does seems to be worthy of a true hero. In the end, he realises you don’t need to do something dramatic to be a hero.

videos.title: Safety is important
videos.overview: Tip doesn’t want to fasten his safety belt in the car because it’s uncomfortable, it’s tight, it chokes him and he can’t move around. Well then they’ll walk, says Daddy. After taking a walk around the village, Tip realises safety really is important, and he promises he’ll always fasten his safety belt.

videos.title: The School Play
videos.overview: The kindergarten is putting on a play. At the rehearsals, Tip realises he is afraid of getting up and saying his lines in front of his classmates and Miss Maggie. Tip is disappointed, but with Raphael’s valuable advice, he figures out how to overcome his stage fright and be a successful actor.

videos.title: Profession Pup
videos.overview: Tip and Jody realise everybody has a profession… except them! So they decide to find their profession, and they try everything they can think of, with no luck. The two of them are disappointed, but they soon find out that they already have a profession, a very tough one: profession pup!

videos.title: A sister is arriving!
videos.overview: Tip remembers how he felt when he was told he was going to have a sister. He was convinced that mum and dad would replace him with this newcomer.

videos.title: The Lucky Charm
videos.overview: Tip finds a four-leaf clover and is convinced that it will bring him luck. When he loses it, everything seems to go wrong. Miguel helps Tip to understand that bad luck does not exist.

videos.title: The basket of anger
videos.overview: ip and Jody are so angry after losing at cards that they refuse to do anything else. However, with the help of Tip's mother, they build a basket in which they can put all their anger.

videos.title: I've become invisible
videos.overview: The two try to attract the attention of the parents, but they only have eyes for Tip. They think they have become invisible.

videos.title: The most special thing of all things
videos.overview: The fair with the special items is in town, and everybody wants to win something, including Tip. The most rare thing is a friendship which is just as special as his friends'.

videos.title: The Almost truth
videos.overview: Tip claims he never tells a lie. But he tells some almost-truths! Mommy explains to him that almost-truths can do as much damage as lies, but Tip is not convinced. He has lots of fun telling half-truths, but trouble comes along and in the end Tip realises what his mommy meant and promises not to tell any more half-lies… or almost-truths!

videos.title: I'll do it later
videos.overview: It’s Jumper’s birthday, and the teacher asks the pups who would like to make a drawing to use as a birthday card. Tip volunteers right away! At home, he hasn’t forgotten his promise, but he wants to play for a while first… after all, there’s plenty of time! But evening comes and he still hasn’t made the birthday card. Will he manage to keep his promise?!

videos.title: Pay attention to good advice
videos.overview: Tip never follows advice. Not even now that he’s down at the river with his family. Grandpa warns him not to go near the sticky trees, but Tip, impatient to go off with Jody, doesn’t listen to him. The result is disastrous, and Tip realises it’s important to pay attention to advice. From then on, whenever someone has advice to offer, he’s all ears!

videos.title: I want to be all right all the time
videos.overview: The pups are at kindergarten, playing with plasticine. Tessa has made a figurine, but it won’t stand up. Tip gives her some advice and she fixes it. Tip is happy, and spends the rest of the day convinced he’s always right. But the afternoon has some surprises in store: he’ll soon realise he can’t be right all the time, and he doesn’t want to be, either!

videos.title: I can do it too
videos.overview: Henry entertains his friends with a magic trick, and Tip thinks he can do it too, but when he tries, he can’t. When Henry tries to explain the trick to him, Tip proudly refuses to listen, telling him he knows how to do it, just not using buttons! Then he goes off in a huff. But an afternoon with Grandpa helps him realise that if you know how to do something properly, it’s a lot easier.

videos.title: Leave the jest when it pleases you best
videos.overview: As the family is setting the table for lunch, Tip puts the tablecloth over his head and jumps out from behind the door, making Daddy jump; everyone laughs. Then Tip sneaks up on Grandpa while he’s reading his newspaper and makes him jump, too. For the rest of the day Tip has fun making everyone jump: his Mommy, his aunts… but after a while nobody laughs any more, and he wonders why...

videos.title: I don't want to take a nap
videos.overview: Tip doesn’t want take an afternoon nap. Mommy and Daddy tell him how important it is to rest, and that he’ll be tired before bedtime if he doesn’t. But Tip refuses to listen to them. And for a while he seems to be right, but by the time he gets to Jody’s party, Tip is too tired to have fun. In the end, he has to admit that he should carry on taking his afternoon nap.

videos.title: We'll take care of it
videos.overview: One Saturday morning in Spring, Mommy has to go out, and Daddy and Tip are sure they can manage just fine without her. But sometimes things are not as easy as they seem!

videos.title: It's a secret
videos.overview: Tip just can’t keep a secret. It’s no good: secrets burst out of him, like sneezes! But, with Nutty’s help, Tip learns how to keep a secret in order to play a game or surprise somebody. He recognises the importance of keeping a secret when he sees how happy Mommy is about the surprise party organised for her: it can be hard to keep a secret, but sometimes, it really is worth it!

videos.title: I'm too big for kisses!
videos.overview: The teacher measures all the puppies to see how much they have grown and Tip is the only one who has not even grown an inch. His mother greeted him with a kiss on the head, which flattened his forelock.

videos.title: Don't be noisy
videos.overview: Tip and Jody play in the park and make a lot of noise. At the request of the mothers they decide not to speak anymore as they understand that noise can be annoying.

videos.title: I'm awake, let's get up!
videos.overview: The first day of vacation arrives and Tip is very happy because you can always play and also sleep longer in the morning. But in the morning Tip wakes up early and wants everyone to get up as well.

videos.title: It's new, so I'm not going to use it
videos.overview: Daddy has brought Tip and Tippy some playdough. Tip stares at his new playdough but doesn’t want to open it and ruin it. The next day he takes it with him to kindergarten, but comes up with all kinds of excuses not to let his friends use it. While the others are playing and having a good time, he concentrates on guarding his precious new playdough.
